high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter platform. The tweet is by a user named Deedy (@deedydas) and was posted one day ago. The tweet discusses an image generation model called OmniGen2 developed by Chinese researchers. The model is described as capable of performing Photoshop-grade edits on images without affecting other parts of the picture. The tweet includes several examples of how the model can be used: "Make her dress blue" "Make him smile" "(multi image) Put this jacket on him" Deedy also mentions that GPT 4o was not as effective at these tasks.
